router_note: A Cloudflare Worker in front of the two Pages projects must send person slugs to this site and keep card slugs on the existing Next.js /birth-card pages until those hubs move to /card/.

presidents_isolated.note: US presidents birth-card set is isolated under /presidents. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes.

holidays_isolated.note: US federal holiday birth-card set is isolated under /holidays. Fixed § 6103(a) dates only. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes.

nobel_isolated.note: Nobel laureate birth-card set is isolated under /nobel. Day-precision Nobel API dates verified against Wikidata P569. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes.

scotus_isolated.note: Current SCOTUS justices birth-card set is isolated under /scotus. Day-precision SCOTUS.gov dates verified against Wikidata P569. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes.

parks_isolated.note: US National Park birth-card set is isolated under /parks. Dates are Wikipedia National Park establishment, not first monument.

cabinet_isolated.note: Current US Cabinet birth-card set is isolated under /cabinet. VP + 15 secretaries only. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes.

senators_isolated.note: Current US senators birth-card set is isolated under /senators. 100 seats; day-precision Bioguide + Wikipedia + Wikidata P569 must match. Path-split is not activated.

oscars_isolated.note: Academy Award Best Actor / Best Actress birth-card set is isolated under /oscars. Unique winners with day-precision Wikipedia infobox + Wikidata P569 match. Path-split is not activated.

governors_isolated.note: Current US governors birth-card set is isolated under /governors. 50 states only. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes.

tonys_isolated.note: Tony Award Leading Actor / Leading Actress birth-card set is isolated under /tonys. Play and musical. Featured acting is out of scope. Day-precision Wikidata P569 verified against Wikipedia person-page dates when present. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes.

emmys_isolated.note: Primetime Emmy Lead Actor/Actress birth-card set is isolated under /emmys. Drama + comedy lists only. Day-precision Wikipedia infobox dates verified against Wikidata P569. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes.

olympics_summer_isolated.note: Summer Olympic multi-gold birth-card set is isolated under /olympics/summer. Day-precision Wikipedia infobox dates verified against Wikidata P569. Two or more Summer golds. Path-split is not activated. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes.

signers_isolated.note: Declaration signers birth-card set is isolated under /signers. Verified subset only. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes.

rock_hall_isolated.note: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Performers birth-card set is isolated under /rock-hall. Day-precision Wikipedia infobox dates verified against Wikidata P569. Bands expand only listed inducted members. Path-split is not activated.

olympics_winter_isolated.note: Winter Olympic multiple-medalist birth-card set is isolated under /olympics/winter. Wikipedia 8+ list + infobox dates verified against Wikidata P569. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes. Path-split is not activated.

astronauts_isolated.note: NASA astronaut birth-card set is isolated under /astronauts. Day-precision NASA bio dates verified against Wikidata P569. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes.

nfl_hof_isolated.note: NFL Hall of Fame inductee birth-card set is isolated under /nfl-hof. Wikidata P6930 + day-precision P569, verified against ProFootballHOF.com bios when they publish a day. Path-split is not activated. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes.

born_on_isolated.note: Authority upgrade of the live Worker /born-on path. Wikidata notables with day-precision P569. Not a new niche. Path-split is not activated. It must not take celebrity person slugs, /birthday, or live card-meaning routes.

pulitzer_fiction_isolated.note: Pulitzer Prize for Fiction birth-card set is isolated under /pulitzer/fiction. Person-scope winners and joint recipients with day-precision Wikipedia infobox + Wikidata P569 match. Path-split is not activated.

grammys_aoty_isolated.note: Grammy Album of the Year birth-card set is isolated under /grammys/aoty. Primary billed winners with day-precision Wikipedia infobox + Wikidata P569 match. Bands expand only when members have public day-precision DOBs. Path-split is not activated.
